# Teamhub

> Teamhub is an all-in-one workspace platform unifying project management, team chat, documentation, forms, and time-tracking in a single integrated solution.

Teamhub serves teams looking for a unified alternative to fragmented tools like Slack, Trello, and Asana. The platform emphasizes seamless collaboration with kanban boards, real-time chat, shared docs, workflow automation, and time-tracking capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Project Management
- Team Collaboration
- Team Chat
- Task Management
- Kanban Boards
- Time Tracking
- Documentation & Wikis
- Forms & Workflows
- Workflow Automation
- Data Migration
- API Integration
- Lifetime Deal
- Free Trial
- Getting Started

## Core Platform Features

- [Teamhub Homepage](https://teamhub.com): Teamhub homepage showcasing unified platform for projects, chat, docs.
- [Project Management](https://teamhub.com/project-management): Teamhub project management features with kanban boards and task views.
- [Team Chat](https://teamhub.com/chat): Teamhub team chat with real-time communication and task management.
- [Documentation & Docs](https://teamhub.com/docs): Teamhub docs platform for creating and sharing team wikis and documents.
- [Forms & Workflow Automation](https://teamhub.com/forms): Teamhub forms for data capture, intake, and workflow automation.
- [Time Tracking & Billing](https://teamhub.com/time-tracking): Teamhub time-tracking with timesheets, billable tracking, and invoicing.
